intro: Gallywix's Head is a severed trophy taken from Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix, an overseer of the Venture Company operating at the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. It serves as gruesome proof of execution demanded by the Shattered Hand, the covert rogue syndicate based in Orgrimmar.

p: Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix directed operations out of the Venture Company's tower north of the Sludge Fen. After word came that the Venture Co. were planning something on a grand scale, the Shattered Hand dispatched operatives to dismantle the facility entirely. Claiming Puzik Gallywix's head serves as absolute proof to Shenthul in Orgrimmar that the overseer was executed, securing the rogue's standing within the guild.
